versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the ainumbers skill, providing access to a deterministic compliance toolset with 640+ tools and chains.
- Integrates with MCP for zero-egress, in-page computation using synthetic data only.
- Artifacts must be verified with verify_execution_hash and results include a ledger link for independent re-verification.
- Strict rules enforce use of synthetic data only and prevention of PII exposure.
